community: Maskwacis (Ermineskin, Montana, Louis Bull per commissioner), Alexis Nakota Sioux Nation, Métis settlements and First Nations generally
request: keep each First Nation and Métis settlement whole in one district rather than divided, naming Maskwacis (split with Wetaskiwin, Drayton Valley) and Alexis Nakota Sioux (split among Lac Ste. Anne-Parkland, Sturgeon, maybe Drayton Valley)
quote: I would urge this commission to look closely at also the Métis settlements and the First Nations, that we are keeping them together is, more often than not, the needs of those communities will be better represented and reflected with one representative in the Legislature rather than being divided.
note: Record does not state she is a member of a nation, so coded non_member. Her concern mixes poll locations ('four different polls') with district division; the explicit ask is one representative, i.e. one district per community. Alexis named on EB-75/76: 'Alexis Nakota Sioux Nation. I believe they're divided into Lac Ste. Anne-Parkland, and then Sturgeon and maybe Drayton Valley.' Ermineskin/Montana/Louis Bull named by Mr. Clark, not her.
